== Biography ==
Jenny was the daughter of Robert & Rosanna (Barclay) Glasgow. Jenny was born in Rockbridge Co., Va. Jenny married 18 Apr 1805, to Thomas Elder Patton, son of John & Martha (Sharp) Patton. Thomas was born 29 Jan 1783, in Rockbridge Co., Va. They moved from Rockbridge County, Virginia traveling by covered wagon to Adams County, Ohio. in Oct. 1806, and settled on the West Fork of Brush Creek. The last of the Shawnee Indians had left the year before their arrival. They were members of the Associated Reformed Church. Thomas farmed for a living.

Most of their children all left Adams County & moved west in the 1840's. They were the parents of 11 children:
John H. Patton, born 7 Feb 1806, died ?;
Robert Glasgow Patton, born 17 Mar 1808, married Esther Malinda McIntyre, moved to Monmouth, Ill, had 9 children; Martha Sharp Patton, born 5 Mar 1810, married Gen. William McIntire, had 10 children, lived Adams Co., Oh;
Joseph Benjamin Patton, born 31 Aug 1812, married, first Jane Finley, second Anna Carithers, had 8 children, moved to Hanna City, Ill; Margaret W. Patton, born 31 Jul 1814, married John McIntyre, had 8 children, moved to Louisa Co., Iowa; Nathaniel Cyrus Patton, born 24 Oct 1816, married, first Margaret Black Glasgow, second Eliza Jane ?, had 10 children, moved to Hanna City, Ill;
William Patton, born 14 Jan 1818, died 1909;
Hadassah Jane Patton, born 13 Jan 1819, married Samuel Steele Glasgow, had 6 children, lived Hanna City, Ill; Thomas Elder Patton, born 14 Aug 1822, married Martha Ann Finley, had 12 children, lived Hanna City, Ill;
James Campbell Patton, born 14 Apr 1827, married Sarah Graham Hart, had 12 children, lived Page Co., Iowa;
Phoebe Patton, born 13 Jan 1830, married Samuel Turner Baldridge, had 3 children, & she died, age 20, after childbirth, 3 Aug 1850, buried Cherry Fork, Adams Co., Ohio.

=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''Jane Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-12]] is assessed at 75% (probable). Jane’s 1785 Rockbridge birth and 1805 Patton marriage suit Robert’s Virginia household. The marriage citation and memorial do not expose a father field; sibling-family attribution is supporting inference.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

Next useful test: Read the cited Faris child passage and its underlying family/Bible/probate authority; compare Robert’s named children.

Source basis already held: [https://search.worldcat.org/title/22731567 David Faris, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio: A Genealogy of the Descendants of Robert Glasgow (1749-1839) and His Wife Rosanna of Bush Creek, Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore: Gateway Press, 1990); WorldCat catalogue record (https://search.worldcat.org/title/22731567).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
